# SpecFence vs OCC Soft=0 TPS — 99-block corpus

**Land:** E1–E4 on PR #38 tip `37eb27b`. Sweep head `8b2f9bc`.
**Method:** `SPECFENCE_ALL_BLOCKS=all` Soft=0, N=3 reuse @8, `profile.release.lto=false`.
**TPS:** `n_tx / wall_seconds` (median of 3). SF/OCC TPS >1 means SpecFence faster.
**Wall:** SF/OCC (median). One empty block (`19910734`, n=0) is listed; TPS aggregates use n>0.
